{{Otheruses|Cannon}}
[[File:Fringer-EotECR.png|thumb|right|200px|A master hunter wearing a shoulder-mounted cannon.]]
{{Quote|We cannot get past their cannons, sir.''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>''Cannons?'' This will never do. We must pull back and set up our deflector shields.|[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] and [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]]|audio=ThisWillNeverDo-TCWf.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
A '''cannon''' was a term used to describe powerful weapons that fired heavy projectiles or bursts of energy. Some were small enough to be carried by a person, while larger versions were mounted on vehicles and [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

==Description==
[[File:Cody_big_gun.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Clone Commander Cody firing a Z-6 rotary blaster cannon.]]
Cannons came in various sizes and levels of power. The [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] included a portable, shoulder-fired version that was small enough to be carried and fired by a single person. Because of their design, [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] could be built with powerful cannons that were integrated into their systems. Examples of these included the [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droid]], the [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droid]], and the [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]].

Other cannons were too large to be carried and needed to be mounted on a tripod or fired from a stationary position. The largest of these were used as ground emplacements or [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]]. Examples of these included the [[air defense tower]], the [[Gormak cannon]], the [[Harnaidan defensive cannon]], and the [[LR1K sonic cannon/Legends|LR1K sonic cannon]]. Despite its size, the [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon]] was actually able to move due to its built-in [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]].

Powerful cannons were also mounted on vehicles and starships, such as [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. One of the largest ion cannons ever constructed was the [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannon]], which was used by the starship [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. An immensely large laser cannon was the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]], which was generally installed in banks on [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and [[Space station/Legends|space stations]].
